name: Ōe no Chisato
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 23); Porter’s note gives the dates as: lived c. end of 9th century.

poems.title: This night the cheerless autumn moon
poems.author: Ōe no Chisato
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 23
poems.text:
This night the cheerless autumn moon
Doth all my mind enthrall;
But others also have their griefs,
For autumn on us all
Hath cast her gloomy pall.
